profile.summary: SCA Environmental, Inc. is an environmental and engineering consulting firm founded in 1992. It provides hazardous materials management, asbestos and lead management, industrial hygiene, site assessment and environmental engineering services to government and private clients. It has offices in San Francisco and Oakland, California.
